name: hypertest-monorepo
description: Hypertest: an evidence-driven, multi-model, durable autonomous testing agent.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.eval:gate: node bin/hypertest.js eval run core --arms scripted-multi-llm --out .hypertest-eval/core-candidate.json && node bin/hypertest.js eval gate --baseline packages/eval/baselines/core-scripted-multi-llm.json --candidate .hypertest-eval/core-candidate.json --report .hypertest-eval/core-gate.md
